description: This file defines the BudgetsRepository class responsible for managing category budgets locally using SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load, save, and update the spent amount for each budget.

classes.name: BudgetsRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages category budgets, storing and retrieving budget data from shared preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of budgets from local storage; if none exists, initializes with default budgets and saves them.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves the list of budgets to local storage.

methods.name: addSpent
methods.description: Updates the spent amount for a specific budget by a delta value and saves the updated list.
